The starting point

A changing world.
A model standing still.

Test data arrives unlabeled. Learning from it with backpropagation takes far more compute and memory than inference, a budget deployed devices rarely have.

We need learning
as cheap as inference.

Can a model learn with the bare minimum: two forward passes per sample, for both prediction and update?

Challenges & insights

Why two-forward learning suffers,
and how EVA-0 fixes it.

Two passes are more informative than they appear
